cases.title: Turning a quiet café page into one that sells
cases.summary: A McLaren-branded café in Qatar was posting videos nobody saw. From Lahore, my team and I rebuilt their page, their edits and their offers, and cut versions that ran on digital billboards across the city.
challenge: Their videos weren't getting reach, and the page itself looked rough, so even the people who found it didn't stay.
They are in Qatar and we work from Pakistan. Every shoot happened without us in the room.
The footage that came back wasn't shot the way the edits needed it. Making that footage look good was a job of its own.
approach: Revamped the whole page: profile, highlights and the grid, so it looks like one brand.
Built an edit style and a colour look for the café and kept every video in it.
Rescued weak footage in the edit with pacing, framing and colour instead of asking for reshoots.
Cut every hero video in several ratios, so the same edit ran as reels, as paid ads and on digital billboards.
Designed posts and offer campaigns, and managed the page week to week, on every deadline.
results: Views and reach went up on their videos.
Our edits went up on digital billboards and ran as ads in different locations.
Sales went up, and every new offer post pulled stronger numbers than the last.
The client paid a bonus on top of the agreed fee, and they still work with us today.
